name: ApprovalAuditTrailExplorer
tagline: The Approval Audit Trail Explorer shows the full history of your approval requests - who submitted, approved, rejected, edited, delegated or escalated each request, and…
description: The Approval Audit Trail Explorer shows the full history of your approval requests - who submitted, approved, rejected, edited, delegated or escalated each request, and when - and checks that history for compliance problems. It reads any table, view or collection that has one row per audit event.
features: Per-request timelines with field changes (old to new)
A sortable log that turns into cards on phones

Built-in compliance checks (self-approval, same approver on several stages, approval over authority limit, edits after approval, rubber-stamp approvals, acting after closure, out-of-hours actions, rejections without a reason) with severity, search
Action / actor / severity / date filters, multi-select
Flag / Mark reviewed / Open / Copy CSV actions and Power Fx outputs and events
